title: Coral and the Static Again
author: Tamsin Oyelaran
blurb: Cyrus Zhou, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
